mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a manufacturing recession, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days as the weakness spreads to the broader economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, signaling a restrictive monetary policy, S&P 500 returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs pressure economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by > 10% y-o-y while the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y decline > 10% and UNRATE rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth (proxied by PAYEMS) accelerates by > 200k jobs per month for 3 consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 200k jobs/mo for 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (proxied by CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% y-o-y while the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals an inflationary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten policy.
regime_hint: inflation scare during accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL y-o-y > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (proxied by RSAFS) declines by > 5% y-o-y for 2 consecutive months, it signals a consumer recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS y-o-y decline > 5% for 2 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
